blockingIssues.description: Refresh rebuilds the Department/Responsible/Goal/Status selects without restoring values from appState.view.filters, so active filters can remain applied while the visible controls appear reset to 'All'.

Search text is only committed to appState.view.filters.search after a 200ms debounce, but Refresh fetches immediately, so a just-entered search term can be lost and the narrowed state is not coherently preserved.
Global Escape handling bails out whenever focus is inside a text-entry control, preventing the required unwind order of scope, expanded row, then filter panel after normal search/filter interaction.
